headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Risk Assessment
summary: Utilize public trend signals to integrate real-time risk assessment features into ClearInstall, improving its ability to detect and warn users about potential security threats during npm or PyPI installations. Enhance the user interface for better visibility of binding.gyp command expansions, ensuring users can make informed decisions before running installs.
actions: Integrate real-time threat intelligence feeds from Gathin23/cleanyourtv to scan and alert on potential vulnerabilities in package dependencies.
Develop a dynamic UI that highlights specific risks associated with binding.gyp commands during installations, based on signals from deepseek-ai/DeepInfer and Z
Implement a feature that cross-references package names against known malicious repositories, inspired by pengchujin/aerial-tv and ly05010419/MacNativeGames to
